newsitem.title: BANGLADESH: Bangladesh taka ends steady in dull market.
newsitem.headline: Bangladesh taka ends steady in dull market.

text.p: The Bangladesh taka closed steady at 42.5250/5325 to the dollar amid poor trading in the interbank market ahead of the Moslem Friday weekend, dealers said. This compared with the previous close at 42.5250/5350.
The taka was quoted stronger at 42.5100/5300 per dollar in early trade, but lost out later as major players stayed out of the market.
Bank transactions in Bangladesh close two hours earlier on Thursday than normally scheduled.
The interbank call money rates finished flat at 7.0 to 7.5 percent. -- Dhaka Newsroom +880-2-506363
